column1: # Shaw (Rankov 2012 ch.8) Table 8.1: effect of a following wind on the oarsmen's burden.
# Source: Rankov 2012 p.71 (PDF page 83). Decoded via OCR (easyocr) of 6x render + equation cross-check.
#   true_tailwind_mps   : true (over-land/over-water) following-wind speed V in m/s
#   relative_wind_mps   : speed of the relative wind pressing on the sails = V - 4.4 m/s
#                         (ship's speed 7.5 kt = 3.9 m/s plus the 0.5 m/s favourable current)
#   sail_force_pct      : X = propulsive force of the sails as a percentage of that required to
#                         maintain the ship's speed at 7.5 kt (3.9 m/s)
#   balance_oars_pct    : balance of the force still to be provided by the oars (100 - X)
# Verification: sail_force_pct reproduces X = 100*((V-4.4)/4.6)^2 to the printed integer
